_comment: Echo Management panels OCRd by tesseract.js 7 with the app's pass plan (src/scanner/pipeline.ts readPanel: 5 OCR passes, the filter-tag pass and the gold "Equipped by" pixel check) via scripts/scan-spike.ts: 17 of the user's own 2026-10-16 screenshots (no Sonata filter set), 16 frames of their 2026-10-22 recording (Windward Pilgrimage filter) and 51 frames of their 2026-10-23 recording (five filters, an unfiltered start and the in-game Filter sheet opening between them); one frame per segment found by src/scanner/video.ts. words/tag = [text, x0, y0, x1, y1] in source-frame pixels; tag = the filter-tag pass; equipLine = the gold line box or null. expected = hand-read from the images (human units, on-screen order; filterTag = the in-game Sonata filter tag text, null if none is visible), never derived from parser output.
